Question: What is something that needs to be said that nobody wants to hear?
Answer: While I was watching an online class, a notification popped up reading- A woman is raped every 5 hours, 10 mins in Delhi. While the overall number of crimes against women decreased in 2020 when compared to the previous year owing to the 4 months of lockdown, the national capital still reported 1,699 rapes, 2,186 instances of molestation and 65 cases of sexual assault against children. This numbers just represents Delhi. What about the other parts of India ? This numbers states only about rape and molestation of women. What about rape of men ? What about rape of LGBTQ+ ? Sadly, at present we don't have rape laws for men and other genders. Sexual offenses in the law is described only against women. Law describes only women as a victim of sexual offense and men as a perpetrators of it. Even after decriminalization of section 377 by which carnal sexual intercourse was legalized, which ultimately widened the scope of law. Still at present, we don't have proper laws to address the issue with regards to sexual abuse of men and other genders. After reading this, I was thinking - Who should be blamed for this ? Police or system ? No, I don't think so they needs to be blamed. Ofcourse flaws are everywhere. System is at fault. Loop holes are present. But, is this only about system and it's execution ? They are not to be blamed in entirety. I think we as a society have failed. How often do we see a headline on rape ? Every single day, right ? Honestly, we all swipe through it unless it gets a lot of media coverage. Problem is we have normalized rape and it's consequences. Because we as an individual think that nothing can be done about it. We don't have our anything to offer in this. The real problem lies here. Rape and sexual offenses are pervasive in nature. It revolves around the way we think, the way we speak and the way we live in this society. Although there may be different context for rape,however it is deeply rooted in the patriarchal mindset of power and control. There are reasons or let's say a person has an intention when he/she commits any crime. But, have you ever thought a reason as to why someone could commit rape ? I think no one can provide a reasonable reason for rape. It is done either I think the problem is that we have started normalizing the objectification of human body, irrespective of it's gender. Pornography, nudity, item songs these have become so common nowadays which contributes so much to the objectification. Why do people actually commit rape ? There can be many sort of reasons but majorly it lies in - And I think, due to easy availability of internet, the exposure to pornography among young kids is very common. Young people fail to distinguish between what they see and what the real women is. We need to talk about this without any shame or judgment. No one is born a criminal or rapist. They are made the one. Men who have been through sexual or physical or emotional abuse during childhood tends to be vulnerable to these crimes. Who creates rapists ? We do, as a society. It's a high time we need to have a broader approach with respect to rape and sexual offense. Rape and sexual offenses affects all the gender and the sexuality. We need to look beyond the sexual orientation of a person when talking about such offenses. Gender neutral laws with regards to sexual offenses is the urgent need of the hour. It's the time that we all see gender as a spectrum instead of two opposing set of ideals. We should stop defining each other by who we are not and start defining ourselves by who we are. Question: How did one experience change your view of life?
Answer: I finished writing my exams this week only. I am on a break for a week, then again grind will begin. So, my sister has a coloring book and once in a while when I am bored I borrow the book from her and fill colours in it. Yesterday, I was coloring this picture. Did you find anything new ? No, right ? Just a ship 🚢 seems sailing in the sea. But, while I was coloring this picture, it made me to look at life with a different perspective. Below are the observations that I made while coloring the picture - Can u see in the picture, the windows lane of the ship. Only windows are colored. While coloring I was confused which color to fill in. I thought it for a while. Then, I decided k I will complete the picture first and then will think of it later. Once I was done coloring the picture, I again started to think of a color which would look good. I was thinking, thinking. But, after sometime I realized that it looks better uncolored. That void space is complementing the whole picture. Even if I add a color, it will seem crowded. This is the case with our life. Sometimes we often ponder upon things, why certain things happened the way it did ? why I did not get what I wanted ? what if I was this and that ? We waste our precious time while looking for answers to this question. But we fail to realize that somethings don't have or even don't need an answer. It's better if they are left the way they are. Constantly putting an effort to such things will take away our mental piece and will not yield anything. If left the way they are, they will definitely add beauty to your life. 2. Value people who care and love you. Can you see the clouds in the picture ? What color is it in the cloud ? Blue right ? Yes, certainly there is a blue color filled in the clouds. But, after filling the blue color, I put white color on it, just to add a gradient and make it look more pretty. But you can't see it ,right ? That's what role our loved ones play in our life. We may not everytime recognize and appreciate there presence but certainly they are there, adding beauty and value to our life. They are the ones who constantly keep us in there prayers and blessings. They would never want anything wrong for us. They will just stay, without you even knowing. So, value them. Appreciate there presence. Tell that you love them. Thank them for there presence. It will definitely make them happy. 3. Some mistakes can't be erased You see the steam coming out of the ship. As I started coloring the clouds, I mistakenly thought that steam is a cloud too. I colored the steam with blue 🤦‍♀️. Then I realized that it's not a cloud. It made me upset for few seconds. So, I thought I will just try to erase the blue. I end up using half eraser to rectify the error. Color did fade away but not too much, it was still visible. While erasing, the page many a times came on the verge of breaking. So, I thought let's just put another color on it. I thought to put brown. But still blue is visible. But how does that matter ? it's okay. ̶M̶i̶s̶k̶a̶t̶e̶s̶, Mistakes are part of you. It doesn't make you any worse. It's not the mistake that matters, it's how you deal with it, what you learn from it and how you apply the lesson in your life. Take chances, make mistakes. That's how we grow. Mistakes are what we often call them experience later. Few years later these mistakes will be your strength, learned lessons and will give you a sense of pride that you made it through. So, it's okay to make mistakes, unless you don't repeat them and you don't learn from them. 4. Broken but beautiful ❤ While coloring the picture, my sister who was also coloring besides me, broke a crayon :( . She - Yaar, I broke a crayon man. I - What difference does that make ? It still colors the same. She - Okay, okay. Don't give me gyaan. I know. I - Huh, whatever. The broken still colors the same. Infact, the edges of it, became more sharper than before, which allowed to color easily at narrow spaces. How beautiful is this ? Broken but beautiful ❤. This is what makes life more beautiful. Somethings at some point of time seems broken to us. But, eventually we realize that the healing process made something very beautiful out of broken. All of your mistakes, worries, failures, define you. They are a part of you. Embrace them. They add meaning to your life. Make them worth your efforts. We do not see things as they are, rather we see things as WE ARE 💞. Our thoughts shape our vision. We see what we choose to see. It's just the matter of perspective.

Question: What is a random thought you’ve had today?
Answer: Today I and my sister went out to buy some household stuff. We reached the supermarket. Guess who was so lazy to go inside and bring stuff ? Ya, that was me. I asked my sister to go inside the store while I waited outside for her. I was inside my car, a soft music was playing, cool environment in the car was giving me comfort. I was just about to pass out, I saw a lady crippling from the opposite road. She was young and was extremely skinny. Her hairs seemed like they were deadlocks. She was carrying some 2 small packets in her hands. The sun was scorching outside. The lady was barefooted. She just came near the store. Adjacent to the store there was a ATM and 2 shops which were closed. The ATM was situated in the corner and there was no sunlight there. That place seemed cool. The other two closed shops were soaking the sunlight. I saw lady approaching towards that side. I thought she will go and sit near the ATM where there is a shadow. To my surprise she didn't sit there and instead chose to sit in sunlight. I was surprised because it was already heating outside, any prudent man would choose to sit in the shadow rather in the sunlight. I was just observing her. As she sat she hastily started opening the packet which she carried. Her hands were trembling. She was trying so freaking hard to open the packet but she was not able to do it. She tried for good 2 minutes. Now, she started tearing the packet with her teeth. I could feel her frustration. She again tried to force open the packet. She failed. I can not explain what I felt at that moment. I was feeling very weird. I looked around myself, I was peacefully chilling in the car doing nothing, while that lady was struggling so hard to just open that packet and eat the food inside. I felt grateful for myself and I felt miserable for her. I was happy for myself and I was sad for her. Too many contradictory emotions and feelings were residing in me. I would just have believed that - ‘may be it's her destiny’. But no I have to overthink. I have to put some efforts in making meaning out of meaningless. I started to think - What if everyone around is successful ? What if everyone of us in this world are same, same in terms of status, standing, etc.? Will there be any difference in this world if everyone is equal ? What would be the scenario if this thing comes true? Now, what if every poor has a car and was chilling inside like I was doing ? What were to happen if every poor becomes rich. Every failure becomes a success. Every sadness turns into happiness. Every wrong become right and so on. After some time I realized that every person here gets what they deserve. If all the people become rich, successful and so called eminent personalities who would care about the work these poor, unsuccessful people do ? The work they do is indispensable in our daily lives. If the watchman become rich who will guard my building ? If the maid becomes rich who will do the domestic help ? What if this lower class people become rich then who will play their role in the society. This world is designed to create equality. Equality amongst people. So that everyone has their job to do. So that everyone has their role to play. Yet this equality seems unequal, right ? This world creates equality, yet we strive to become unequal. P.S - Here I have no intent to demean or derogate any class of the society. Until we meet again, Rabiya

Question: How can I be happy?
Answer: Few nights back, it was 1AM in the night. I was just randomly scrolling through my phone. No excitement. Just blindly looking at the screen. I decided to switch to prime and netflix instead, just in a hope to find a hidden gem. I was feeling unmotivated to do something productive out of my time. A slight uneasiness was slowly creeping over me. I was just looking for escapism for sometime. My younger sister was sitting beside me, studying for her exams. She saw what I was doing and recommended me to fill colours in her coloring book. I denied. She asked me ‘why ?’. Honestly, I just couldn't really think of the answer. I randomly told her that ‘you may still be a kid who fills colors in the coloring book, but I am not that type of person'. After ignoring her recommendation I could have again started to search for something to watch, but I felt a slight tinge of guilt. I realized that I was being narrow minded and fussy. I took my sister's recommendation and started coloring the book. It turned out that my inclination towards watching something, which I was too reluctant to drop - was proven to be wrong. 90 minutes passed and I was feeling different than before. That uneasiness was gone. The escapism which I was looking for was found in my sister's suggestion. As I went to sleep that night, I was at peace. I revisited all my childhood memories. I could feel all my memories flashing before my eyes. I felt more connected with the world - the colours, my people, my bessstt friends❤, everything which I was blessed with felt very different that night. I just filled colours into some papers. Such a small and childish thing. But it mattered, it made a huge difference. I just realized that above example might seem insignificant. But in my experience, these tiny little things add up over time and add magical moments to our lives. They put something magical in our daily monotonous life. Just come out of your lazy comfort zone and say ‘yes’ to things often. A closed mind is a hoax. Keep your mind open, otherwise life will just pass you by, without realizing that you failed to live many magical moments. In this way moments of joy, happiness turns into days, weeks, months and years of joy. Happiness is just a state of mind. We either make ourselves happy or miserable. Efforts and amount of work required in both remains the same. ~ Probably some of best things that happened to you, was because you said ‘yes' to someone. Or else things would have remained just the same. Until we meet again, Rabiya 🌈

Question: What made you upset today?
Answer: Seriously Bombay High Court ? In a recent ruling by the Nagpur bench of the Bombay High Court, it was observed that there should be "skin-to-skin contact with sexual intent" in order to be considered as sexual assault. The ruling also said that 'mere groping' will not fall under sexual assault. The High Court further ruled that mere touching the chest of the minor will not amount to sexual assault unless the accused removes clothes of the victim or slid hands inside the garments, making it a physical contact. The sexual assault under the POCSO Act involves committing assault with sexual intent and getting physical without penetration by touching the private parts of the child or making the child touch the private organs of the accused, noted the judge in the court hearing. "The act of pressing the breast of a child aged 12 years, in the absence of any specific detail as to whether the top was removed or whether he inserted his hand inside her top and pressed her breast, would not fall under the definition of ‘sexual assault'," the judge held, adding, "it would certainly fall within the definition of section 354 of the IPC, which penalises outraging the modesty of a woman." Ironically today 24th Jan is celebrated as National Girl Child Day in India. Edit - I know that the man was punished under s.354 IPC under the offense of outraging the modesty of women. Here the court specifically stated that skin to skin contact is necessary for the offence od sexual assault under POSCO. This statement of the court doesn't make sense. Just because there is a barrier of a cloth that doesn't mean that it isn't a physical contact. Edit 2 - (27–1–20) - Supreme court has now put this order on stay and also notices has been issued to the accused and the Maharashtra government. Now, Supreme court will look into the matter. Source- Groping 'Without Skin-To-Skin Contact' Does Not Qualify As Sexual Assault: Bombay HC

Question: What disgusts you?
Answer: My dad believes in charity. He makes sure that once in a week, he distributes food to poor and needy. Last week he was out of the town for work, so he called and told me to distribute the food among poor people in the nearby vicinity. I agreed. So next day, I went to a restaurant and ordered 50 parcels of the food. After the food was ready, I went to nearby slum, where many poor people used to live. More than half of the food packets were distributed there. Then, I moved forward and saw a lady who was sitting a bit far on a footpath. I took my vehicle there, and gave her a packet of the food. That lady suddenly started crying. I consoled her and gave her water. She was sobbing in pain. I asked her what happened? Lady- Beta, meri bhi tere jaisi beti hai, hum dono idhar hee rehte the aur idhar hee sote the (I also have a daughter like you, we both used to live here and sleep here) I - Accha aunty aap ro kyu rahe ho, aap aise hee bol dete mai aapko aur ek khaane ka packet de deti hu. (Okay aunty, you don't need to cry, take this one more packet of food for your daughter) Lady- Arre, nai beta. Mai khaana nai maang rahi hu. (No, I am not asking for food) I - Toh phir aunty kya hua aapko? Aap itna kyu ro rahe ho? (So, what happened to you aunty, why are you crying so much) Lady - Mai aur meri beti 8 din pehle yahi par soye the. Raat ko achanak ek gaadi par 2 log aaye aur meri beti ko uthaakar le gaye. Mai kuch karu usse pehle woh log meri beti ko lekar chale gaye. ( I and my daughter were sleeping here 8 days before. Suddenly, in the middle of night , 2 guyz came and took my daughter away. I couldn't do anything.) After listening to this I was completely blank. I didn't know what to tell her. I could only see that lady crying infront me. I was helpless. I- Aunty, aap ne kch kiya nai kya? Police mai complaint kee aapne? (Aunty, have you reported this at police station) Lady - Arre beta, police hamari kaha sunti hai. Mai gayi thee police station, maine bola unko. Mere pass meri beti ka photo bhi nai hai. Unhone bola ke photo ke bina hum kaise dhunde tumhari beti ko. ( I went to the police station, but they don't listen to poor people like us. I don't have a photograph of my daughter and they told it's not possible to find your daughter without her photograph.) I - Aunty aap tension mat lo, aapki beti mil jayegi. (Aunty don't be tensed,your daughter will come back) After listening to that lady, I was awestruck. And yes I gave her my number and asked her to call me if she needs anything. Image source- Google No, I am not here to blame police or administration of justice. What makes me sad is that how some humans have become so heartless. What makes them to do such acts, what compels them to commit such things ? What disgusts you? Helplessness. That feeling when you know something is wrong somewhere, someone is in trouble somewhere, but still you can't do anything. You just stand still, with no hope, no strength, all blank. This disgusts me.
